//Do not use architecture specific optimizations (like '-march=armv8.1-a'

//Force no use of padding even in DEBUG mode etc.
MI_NO_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Disable transparent huge pages support on Linux/Android for the
// mimalloc process only
MI_NO_THP:BOOL=OFF

//Use plain C compilation (has priority over MI_USE_CXX)
MI_NO_USE_CXX:BOOL=OFF

//Only for optimized builds: turn on architecture specific optimizations
// (for x64: '-march=haswell;-mavx2' (2013), for arm64: '-march=armv8.1-a'

//Use SIMD instructions (requires MI_OPT_ARCH to be enabled)
MI_OPT_SIMD:BOOL=OFF

//Use interpose to override standard malloc on macOS
MI_OSX_INTERPOSE:BOOL=ON

//Use malloc zone to override standard malloc on macOS
MI_OSX_ZONE:BOOL=ON

//Override the standard malloc interface (i.e. define entry points
// for 'malloc', 'free', etc)
MI_OVERRIDE:BOOL=ON

//Enable padding to detect heap block overflow (always on in DEBUG
// or SECURE mode, or with Valgrind/ASAN)
MI_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Enable the allocation sampling profiler
MI_PPROF:BOOL=ON

//Use security mitigations (like meta data guard pages, allocation
// randomization, double-free mitigation, and free-list corruption
// detection)
MI_SECURE:BOOL=OFF

//Use full security mitigations including guard pages at the end
// of each mimalloc page (may be expensive)
MI_SECURE_FULL:BOOL=OFF

//Generate assembly files
MI_SEE_ASM:BOOL=OFF

//Show error and warning messages by default (only enabled by default

MI_SHOW_ERRORS:BOOL=OFF

//Skip collecting memory on program exit
MI_SKIP_COLLECT_ON_EXIT:BOOL=OFF

//Force TLS model based on fixed thread local slots
MI_TLS_MODEL_FIXED:BOOL=OFF

//Force TLS model based on thread local variables
MI_TLS_MODEL_LOCAL:BOOL=OFF

//Force TLS model based on pthreads
MI_TLS_MODEL_PTHREADS:BOOL=OFF

//Force a recursion check on thread local access (for MI_TLS_MODEL_LOCAL
// only)
MI_TLS_RECURSE_GUARD:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with address sanitizer support (adds a small overhead)
MI_TRACK_ASAN:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with Windows event tracing (ETW) support (adds a small
// overhead)
MI_TRACK_ETW:BOOL=OFF

//Compile with Valgrind support (adds a small overhead)
MI_TRACK_VALGRIND:BOOL=OFF

//Use the C++ compiler to compile the library (instead of the C
// compiler)
MI_USE_CXX:BOOL=OFF

//Explicitly link with -latomic (on older systems) (deprecated
// and detected automatically)
MI_USE_LIBATOMIC:BOOL=OFF

//Use only direct TLS slots on Windows to avoid extra tests in
// the malloc fast path (only works if the program uses less than
// 64 TlsAlloc'd slots in total)
MI_WIN_DIRECT_TLS:BOOL=OFF

//Use the raw DLL main entry point for mimalloc initialization;
// can be more robust but can also lead to link errors with other
// libraries
MI_WIN_INIT_USE_RAW_DLLMAIN:BOOL=OFF

//Use legacy TLS entries with DllMain for mimalloc initialization
MI_WIN_INIT_USE_TLS_DLLMAIN:BOOL=OFF

//Use redirection module ('mimalloc-redirect') on Windows if compiling

MI_WIN_REDIRECT:BOOL=ON

//Use Fiber local storage on Windows to detect thread termination
// (deprecated)
MI_WIN_USE_FLS:BOOL=OFF

MI_XMALLOC:BOOL=OFF
